Lisandro Martinez's Criticism Sparks Uproar at Manchester United

Lisandro Martinez has reportedly criticized the Manchester United hierarchy, leading to alleged 'shouting and slammed doors' within the club. The criticism, described as an 'explosive interview' or 'epic rant,' followed a defeat to Atletico Madrid. Reports indicate Martinez specifically targeted the club's board. Footage of Martinez with Cristian Romero has also emerged.
